howto.title: How to play
howto.goal: Be the fullest cat when the market closes! Play 5 rounds, collect sets of the same food and eat them for points.
howto.biddingText: Everyone secretly plays a meow card 1–5, then all flip at once. Unique numbers pick from the stall first. Each number works once per game.
howto.trashText: Draw from the trash bin one card at a time into your bag and stop whenever you like — but meet a guard dog without a bone and your bag is lost!
howto.eatText: 3 of the same food = a meal worth its market price. Each meal drops that price by 1, so eating first scores more.
howto.orderRound: Each round shows a tie-break order before you bid: random in round 1, then lowest score first.
howto.orderPickUnique: Unique numbers pick first — highest number first.
howto.orderPickClash: Clashed? You still pick, after everyone who didn't.
howto.orderDigTie: Same number: whoever picked first digs last.
howto.orderEat: Lower numbers eat first (ties follow the tie-break order).
howto.orderSkip: Nothing to eat? Your turn is skipped for you.
howto.scoreMeal: Meal of 3 = its price in points
howto.scoreGold: A golden fish stands in for any food, one per meal
howto.scoreBonus: Eat the most kinds of food (at least 2) for the Foodie Bonus +3
howto.scoreLimit: Hold at most 10 cards at the end of a round — discard the rest
howto.dogText: Bones you dig go straight to your hand (safe). When a dog appears, throw a bone to get away. The emptier the bin, the closer the dogs — watch the bin's mood!
